title: Call Centre Agent - Uncapped Commission
description:
Start Date: 02/11/2026

Full Time Role - 37.5 hours per week

Stanford House Birchwood WA3 7 TH

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Warrington is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Warrington contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE
- GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.
- UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.
- BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.
- GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.
- FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.
- GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Commercial Administrator
description:
1 x Commercial Administrator - Working for a fire and sprinkler company, who work on industrial infrastructure projects

35,000 per annum

Based at our Paddington Office (5 days a week)

Reporting to: Quantity Surveyor

I am looking for someone with construction experience.

Log new enquiries and requests from the client for quotations. Assist with the preparation and issue of quotations. Maintain an accurate project tracker, including quotation value, issue date, status and client response. Follow up outstanding quotations and provide regular updates to the relevant people. Monitor client purchase orders and formal instructions, check purchase orders against quotations to ensure the correct scope, value and reference information has been included.

Ensure works are not progressed commercially without the appropriate authorisation / signed off unless specifically approved by management. Maintain a live variation/change register for active projects. Ensure additional works, design changes and client-requested alterations are recorded. Assist closing out jobs, including documentation is issued and outstanding revenue is identified. Set up and maintain project folders and commercial records. Record key commercial correspondence. Support monthly commercial/project reviews. Verify completed works via citadel & Uptick

title: Clerical Officer
company: North Cheshire and Mersey NHS Foundation Trust (BCH)
advertiser_name: North Cheshire and Mersey NHS Foundation Trust (BCH)
description: You will be a front facing member of our community admin team and as such will be the initial point of contact for patients and visitors at Orford Jubilee Hub. You may be asked to cover at other community clinic sites across our Warrington area in your colleagues absence. This a very busy base both with telephone calls and with face-to-face patient enquiries and is one of the two main sites for community phlebotomy clinic sessions. This is a full-time role Monday Friday 8.30-4.30 To provide administrative and clerical support to the community clinics and associated health professionals, especially the 019 Service. To provide a customer focused service to the users of the clinics. To provide relief cover at other locations as requested. To undertake fire warden duties as required. Job Purpose: To provide administrative and clerical support to the community clinics and associated health professionals; To provide a customer focused service to the users of the clinics; Duties and Responsibilities: To act as first point of contact for all client enquiries, responding to telephone and face to face enquiries in an efficient, tactful and professional manner, redirecting calls, taking action as appropriate. Liaising with internal services and partner agencies when necessary as directed. To carry out general reception duties where required maintaining a neat and tidy reception environment; The maintenance of the patient booking system in the reception function to include the preparation and arrangement of appointments including inputting of referrals ensuring all clerical work resulting is dealt with in a timely manner; To display and ensure availability of information sources at reception with an adequate and attractive display of front desk poster and leaflet materials to include distribution and collation of all patient surveys; To deal with all internal/external mail and redistribution to relevant department; To sell items as required. (i.e. dressings, theraband, vitamins, prescriptions, etc) To accept deliveries and ensure these are dealt with promptly; To ensure vaccine deliveries are stored in accordance with the Immunisation policy where appropriate; To maintain an effective photocopying, filing and archiving system including records management in line with Trust policy; To provide relief cover at other locations as required by Management to include the assistance with the School Health Immunisation Programme; To copy type/audio type medical reports and general correspondence as required; To report any faults, defects or building defects to the CAFM Helpdesk; To maintain appropriate levels of stationery stock; to place requisitions onto the Purchase Ordering system; To book clinic and meeting rooms within the premises and keep room availability updated as appropriate; To update and maintain clinical diaries as requested; To undertake delegated duties commensurate with the banding; Where required with the Service to assist in the collation of records packs as directed; To attend local service meetings as and when directed by Line Manager;

title: Medical Receptionist
description: We are looking for a GP Receptionist to join our friendly GP team based in Golborne due to internal promotion. The working pattern: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday. 1.30pm- 6.30pm General reception duties include, but not limited to: Patient queries, booking patient appointments, checking patients in, making up new patient packs, going through prescriptions and patient to collect box, Telephone queries, New Patient registrations, Process Prescriptions. General patient queries Booking patient appointments Checking patients in Telephone queries New patient registrations Process prescriptions
